input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No MFN or most-favoured-customer obligation runs against Customer anywhere in the agreement: searches for "most favoured/favourable/favorable", "MFN", "no less favo", "best pricing", "benchmark" and third-party-offer matching return nothing burdening us. § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment and preserves our freedom to deal with other suppliers, which meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer). Nothing to redline; the absence of a Vendor-granted MFN in our favour is a commercial nice-to-have, not a playbook deviation.
